title: REDEEM – Connecting Water, Energy, Food and Ecosystems

body:
This gallery documents my involvement in REDEEM activities in Montenegro, supporting an integrated approach to water, energy, food and ecosystems — the WEFE nexus.

The work brings together institutional knowledge, stakeholder perspectives and practical tools to identify interdependencies, assess emerging risks and support coordinated resource management. Cooperation and shared learning help translate these connections into priorities for action and stronger climate resilience.

My contribution includes stakeholder mapping and consultation, governance support, capacity development and carbon footprint assessment. Working with the Ministry of Agriculture, Forestry and Water Management and the expert team, I support the preparation of methodologies, learning resources and tools for project implementation.
